calendar_amendment_before_outcome_review: After input preparation and before summary/statistical outcome inspection, identified2017-09-29 to2017-10-10 as adjacent KR market sessions separated by a national holiday. Stopped unfinished simulation and preserved calendar-draft outputs. Indicators/fills now break only at invalid bars or missing market sessions, not merely >10 elapsed calendar days. No signals, costs, outcome thresholds or OOS splits changed. The original MA-DD source/code behavior remains reproducible. Existing shares and cash continue across true gaps.
input: Reuse pinned MA-DD raw KR marcap and US Yahoo/SEC sources only; 2016-01-01 through available completed 2026-10-15. No old DD events, peak definitions, optimized strategies or source recollection. Check original hashes. US missing delisted population is NOT repaired by historical cap screening; inference is conditional on observed coverage.
entry: False to true state transition only; previous and current SMA20 finite in same valid segment. Floating equality relative tolerance 1e-12. Eligibility at signal close: KR rank1..200; US point-in-time estimated cap>=USD2bn. No future rank.

reentry.C: close crosses strictly above SMA5 from <=
reentry.G: SMA5 crosses strictly above SMA10 from <=

execution: Signal at close, fill at next available valid exchange-session OPEN only. Full precision fractional shares, small price-taking orders. One additional-session delayed-open sensitivity. No same-close fills. Reentry signal strictly AFTER sell signal (sell execution day close allowed); simultaneous sell/reentry signal is not a future rebound.
cycle: Sell HALF CURRENT shares once, retain half; reinvest ONLY net sale cash at first subsequent rebound signal's next open. Ignore all sell signals while out. After repurchase require a new false-to-true transition, not continued bearish state. A new sell transition on repurchase day close is allowed. No stop/profit/maximum holding time or index exit.
gaps: Reuse valid contiguous exchange-session segments for indicators; reset MA at gaps and invalid/zero-volume bars. Never interpolate a tradable bar. A signal whose planned next-session fill is unavailable is unfilled. Existing shares/cash survive gaps; no fictitious liquidation or cycle reset. Reentry requires new valid cross after warmup. Report gap-spanning and stale terminal marks separately; terminal last known price is NOT a delisting payoff.
cost_interpretation: Arrays are sale haircut,buy surcharge. Scenario assumptions for fees/spread/slippage and KR sale-levy allowance, NOT a historical legal tax schedule or guaranteed quotes. Gross/base/stress all reported. Initial holding is endowed in both arms; no entry or terminal liquidation charge. Capital-gains taxes and FX excluded; returns in local currency. Cash interest0 baseline,4% annual sensitivity. KR dividend0 baseline and4% uniform yield sensitivity; US Yahoo adjclose/close total-return-unit sensitivity with unchanged raw-price signals. No fabricated dividend records.
paths: Each symbol starts fully invested at OPEN after its first eligible close on/after2016-01-01, before any strategy sale; run through last valid available price, eligibility controls new sales only. Same start/price/terminal valuation for buy-hold. Report per-stock terminal wealth ratios, CAGR differences for >=1year paths and MDD differences. Fixed Jan2016 contemporaneously eligible inception cohort separately aggregated with equal initial capital, NO rebalancing or future entrants. Historical ends held at last mark explicitly flagged; zero terminal recovery sensitivity for stale stocks. These limitations prevent a fully investable universe-wide claim.
open_cycles: Do not discard or force buy. Value remaining shares plus cash at last mark; separately report open rebound signals lacking next bar, no signal, gap and early series-end. Completed-cycle statistics and censoring counts shown together. Duration survival estimates include right censoring; last-available marks do not resolve delisting returns.
metrics: Cycle price discount=1-buy_open/sell_open; gross total shares increment=.5*(sell_open/buy_open-1); net=.5*((1-sale_cost)/(1+buy_cost)*sell_open/buy_open-1). Also absolute wealth P&L difference per pre-sale capital=.5*((1-sale_cost)-(buy/sell)*(1+buy_cost))/(1+buy_cost). Min close and low from signal through rebound close; sale-to-fill minimum excludes buy day's post-open low. Max peak-to-trough close drawdown, duration, terminal change, P5/25/50/75/95. Immediate: rebound<=3 sessions and low drawdown<1%; give <=1% and <=3-session marginals. Giveback: post-sale low decline>=5% but rebuy>=sale; also10% threshold. Thresholds descriptive, not added trade rules.
A_to_B: All eligible A first entries: already B vs subsequent first B before A ceases vs A episode ends without B vs censored. Report A-close to B-close price and sessions. Do not condition A strategy on later B.
conditions: KR ranks1-50/51-100/101-200; US mid[2,10)bn/large[10,200)bn/mega>=200bn at sale signal. Prior20-return annual sigma quartile cuts estimated ONLY2016-2022 eligible symbol-days, applied unchanged to2023+. Regime: prior-day equal-weight lag-eligible sample-market close-return index above/below trailing200-day MA; explicitly sample proxy, not KOSPI/SP500. Calendar years by sale signal with end-year leakage avoided for training and OOS inference.
validation: Training2016-2022 completed within2022; embargo calendar2023Q1 (not training). Primary temporal holdout new sell signals>=2023-04-01, all6 unchanged; separately fresh OOS paths and fixed cohort from2023-04-03. No parameter tuning or winner replacement. Historical data were used in earlier studies, so this is temporal holdout, NOT virgin prospective evidence.
inference: Primary mean log(1+net_total_share_increment), full and holdout. Equal-stock and event-weight results; crossed symbol x sale-calendar-quarter pigeonhole bootstrap2000, seed20261017,95%CI and familywise Bonferroni intervals for12 market-strategy tests. Quarterly time-block fixed-cohort paired log-return bootstrap2000 for full-period performance. Report mean levels and tails even when positive. No IID event t-test. Conditionals exploratory, no post-hoc strategy selection.
decision: Do not recommend solely from cheaper-rebuy frequency. Require positive held-out net economic gain robust to cost/wealth/income sensitivities, multiplicity and full-period performance; disclose universe/total-return/corporate-action/delisting limitations. A negative finding in observed sample is not proof of no effect in missing stocks. Never claim survivor bias was removed or complete total return when unavailable.
artifacts: Separate runtime/ma-reentry-20261017; immutable input hashes; full cycle and symbol/annual/condition ledgers; executable tests and independent scalar replay; report answers all six user questions. No operating DB, orders, account, monitoring or schedule changes. Local commits only.
